questions.question: Fedin’s no. 43 gives only the surname Kondratyev, without a first name or university. The connection with Vladimir Aleksandrovich Kondratyev is unproved; decide whether to retain or omit this speculative identification in both versions.

localizations.source: Fedin’s no. 43 gives only the surname Kondratyev, without a first name or university. The connection with Vladimir Aleksandrovich Kondratyev is unproved; decide whether to retain or omit this speculative identification in both versions.

questions.question: The text closely follows S. N. Fedin’s anecdote 43, yet authorship and the root rights_basis are assigned entirely to Mansur Gilmullin. Distinguish the source text’s authorship from Mansur’s adaptation and illustration work.
